text:
Owen Tippett came off injured reserve on Nov. 2 and walked straight into trade talk. NHLTradeRumor.com has floated Seattle and Chicago as fits; Yardbarker reported "no traction" on a Tippett-for-Frank Nazar idea. Treat all of that as other people's speculation. What we can tell you is what he's done on the ice: 2 points in 12 games, one goal on 28 shots.

That's a 3.6% shooting rate for a player who scored 28 goals last season, against a normal range we'd put between 10% and 15%. It will turn. The worry is the team around him: the Flyers take only 38% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice, and his minutes have dipped to under 13 a night since he came back.

The tools haven't gone anywhere. His top speed ranks in the 95th percentile and his shot in the 97th, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking from last season says 60% of his shots come off the rush. PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor spotted him on a new line with Sean Couturier and Barkey on Nov. 5. We project about 21 goals. A hot two weeks would change the conversation fast.
headline: Tippett is back, and in the rumor mill
